title: Data Collection Facts Label
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


The American Affordability Tracker




Domain/topic


Cost of living




Source type


Institutional data / Research dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


Urban Institute




Original purpose


A data tool funded by Urban Institute, which is a nonprofit research organization with the goal of equipping changemakers with evidence and solutions to improve lives and strengthen communities.




Collection method


Uses the Missouri Census Data Center’s 2022 Geographic Correspondence Engine crosswalks to convert data from Public Use Microdata Areas (PUMAs), zip codes, and counties (depending on data source) to population-weighted averages by congressional districts. Also uses population-based weights to aggregate up to the state and national levels where needed.




Record-creation event


Updated as new indicators and more recent data becomes available.











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


One geographic area (a national average, state or congressional district) for a specific time period




Population or objects represented


U.S. households, U.S. consumers, and geographic regions




Time period covered


2017 - 2025 (varies by metric)




Geographic area coverage


United States











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Rent, home sale prices, gas prices, grocery prices, and average weekly earnings




Data types included


Numerical (dollar amounts, percentages, credit scores, etc.), text (dictionary definitions), time (months, quarters, years), and location (zip codes, counties, states, congressional districts)




Direct measurements


Average price per gallon of regular gas, average weekly earnings of all employees, average Vantage credit score




Possible proxy variables


Thrifty Food Plan market basket for a family of four is used as a stand in for general grocery costs.











Documentation






Documentation found


Technical Appendix PDF, Data dictionary CSV, ID variables dictionary CSV




Stated collection details


All metrics are available at the national and state level. Data is provided by congressional district using fixed 119th Congress boundaries for all years. Data for some congressional districts may not be available.
